svg.text: REFERENCE ONLY — dated vendor observations, not derived values. Nothing is in a cart. Display and PSU excluded (same purchase whichever design wins).
WHAT EACH DESIGN COSTS — three quotes from one price table

Design 3's phase 1 is design 1 at 0.119 in with 4 magnets instead of 8; its kit is design 2's feet and lower clamp plus 5 ft struts. Design 2's plate is a different part and shares nothing but the strut hardware.

Common to every design: Waveshare 23.8 in FHD touch monitor, SKU 34025, with 12 V 5 A PSU $349.99; Mean Well GST90A12-P1M 12 V 80 W brick $29.50; IEC C13 cord, 6 ft $7.52 = $387.01.
Design 1 vs design 3 phase 1: the same plate and hardware; the difference is the gauge ($197.07 vs $177.77) and four fewer magnets ($95.68).
